remarks: Stunning, sun-filled, "nearly new" condo in desirable Middlesex Commons Complex. Extensively renovated in 2021, including all new kitchen, baths and floors, this second floor ranch-style unit offers easy living in downtown Darien - walking distance to the thriving Corbin District, Whole Foods, the Darien Library, Tilley Pond Park and Metro North Train to NYC. The open-concept floor plan with sliders leading to a private deck overlooking the gardens includes a dining nook, oversized pass-through from kitchen to living room and a wood burning fireplace for chilly winter nights. The Primary Suite with sparkling bathroom offers an additional room that could be used as an office, workout space or walk-in closet. The full sized washer and dryer in the utility closet is an extra bonus. Middlesex Commons Community includes a lovely pool and pool house, as well as a one bedroom cottage available to all owners to book for overnight guests.
